mapper.sql: FROM PAYMENT p JOIN RESERVATION r ON r.RESERVATION_CODE = p.RESERVATION_CODE JOIN CLASS c ON c.CLASS_CODE = r.CLASS_CODE JOIN SCHEDULE s ON s.SCHEDULE_CODE = r.SCHEDULE_CODE JOIN MEMBER m ON m.MEMBER_CODE = r.MEMBER_CODE

CASE WHEN NVL(p.REFUND, 0) >= p.AMOUNT THEN 0 ELSE NVL( (SELECT MAX(ca.AMOUNT) FROM CALCULATE ca WHERE ca.PAYMENT_CODE = p.PAYMENT_CODE), (p.AMOUNT - NVL(p.REFUND, 0)) - ROUND((p.AMOUNT - NVL(p.REFUND, 0)) * 0.1) ) END
mapper.select:
SELECT NVL(SUM(p.AMOUNT), 0) AS TOTAL_PAYMENT_AMOUNT, NVL(SUM(NVL(p.REFUND, 0)), 0) AS TOTAL_CANCEL_AMOUNT, NVL(SUM(), 0) AS EXPECTED_SETTLEMENT_AMOUNT
WHERE c.OPERATOR_CODE = #{authorCode}

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT sales_page.*, ROWNUM AS RN FROM ( SELECT p.PAYMENT_CODE, p.RESERVATION_CODE, c.CLASS_CODE, c.NAME AS CLASS_TITLE, m.NAME AS MEMBER_NAME, s.CLASS_DATE AS SCHEDULE_DATE, p.AMOUNT AS PAYMENT_AMOUNT, NVL(p.REFUND, 0) AS DISCOUNT_AMOUNT, AS SETTLEMENT_AMOUNT, p.STATUS AS PAYMENT_STATUS, CAST(p.PAYMENT_DATE AS DATE) AS PAYMENT_DATE
ORDER BY p.PAYMENT_DATE DESC, p.PAYMENT_CODE DESC ) sales_page WHERE ROWNUM <= #{endRow} ) WHERE RN >= #{startRow}

SELECT p.PAYMENT_CODE, p.RESERVATION_CODE, c.CLASS_CODE, c.NAME AS CLASS_TITLE, s.SCHEDULE_CODE, s.CLASS_DATE AS SCHEDULE_DATE, m.MEMBER_CODE, m.NAME AS MEMBER_NAME, m.EMAIL AS MEMBER_EMAIL, p.MEANS AS PAYMENT_METHOD, p.AMOUNT AS PAYMENT_AMOUNT, 0 AS COUPON_DISCOUNT_AMOUNT, 0 AS POINT_DISCOUNT_AMOUNT, NVL(p.REFUND, 0) AS CANCEL_AMOUNT, 0 AS CANCEL_FEE_AMOUNT, CASE WHEN NVL(p.REFUND, 0) >= p.AMOUNT THEN 0 ELSE ROUND((p.AMOUNT - NVL(p.REFUND, 0)) * 0.1) END AS PLATFORM_FEE_AMOUNT, AS SETTLEMENT_AMOUNT, CASE WHEN p.STATUS = '환불완료' OR NVL(p.REFUND, 0) > 0 THEN '정산제외' WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM CALCULATE ca WHERE ca.PAYMENT_CODE = p.PAYMENT_CODE ) THEN ( SELECT MAX(ca.STATUS) FROM CALCULATE ca WHERE ca.PAYMENT_CODE = p.PAYMENT_CODE ) WHEN r.STATUS != '예약' THEN '정산제외' WHEN TRUNC(s.CLASS_DATE) > TRUNC(SYSDATE) THEN '정산대기' ELSE '정산가능' END AS SETTLEMENT_STATUS, p.STATUS AS PAYMENT_STATUS, CAST(p.PAYMENT_DATE AS DATE) AS PAYMENT_DATE
WHERE c.OPERATOR_CODE = #{authorCode} AND p.PAYMENT_CODE = #{paymentCode}

SELECT NVL(( SELECT SUM((p.AMOUNT - NVL(p.REFUND, 0)) - ROUND((p.AMOUNT - NVL(p.REFUND, 0)) * 0.1)) FROM PAYMENT p JOIN RESERVATION r ON r.RESERVATION_CODE = p.RESERVATION_CODE JOIN CLASS c ON c.CLASS_CODE = r.CLASS_CODE JOIN SCHEDULE s ON s.SCHEDULE_CODE = r.SCHEDULE_CODE WHERE c.OPERATOR_CODE = #{authorCode} AND p.STATUS = '결제완료' AND NVL(p.REFUND, 0) = 0 AND r.STATUS = '예약' AND TRUNC(s.CLASS_DATE) <= TRUNC(SYSDATE) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM CALCULATE ca WHERE ca.PAYMENT_CODE = p.PAYMENT_CODE) ), 0) AS AVAILABLE_AMOUNT, NVL(( SELECT SUM((p.AMOUNT - NVL(p.REFUND, 0)) - ROUND((p.AMOUNT - NVL(p.REFUND, 0)) * 0.1)) FROM PAYMENT p JOIN RESERVATION r ON r.RESERVATION_CODE = p.RESERVATION_CODE JOIN CLASS c ON c.CLASS_CODE = r.CLASS_CODE JOIN SCHEDULE s ON s.SCHEDULE_CODE = r.SCHEDULE_CODE WHERE c.OPERATOR_CODE = #{authorCode} AND p.STATUS = '결제완료' AND NVL(p.REFUND, 0) = 0 AND r.STATUS = '예약' AND TRUNC(s.CLASS_DATE) > TRUNC(SYSDATE) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM CALCULATE ca WHERE ca.PAYMENT_CODE = p.PAYMENT_CODE) ), 0) AS WAITING_AMOUNT, NVL(( SELECT SUM(ca.AMOUNT) FROM CALCULATE ca WHERE ca.OPERATOR_CODE = #{authorCode} AND ca.STATUS IN ('정산대기', '정산보류') ), 0) AS REQUESTED_AMOUNT, NVL(( SELECT SUM(ca.AMOUNT) FROM CALCULATE ca WHERE ca.OPERATOR_CODE = #{authorCode} AND ca.STATUS = '정산완료' ), 0) AS COMPLETED_AMOUNT, NVL(( SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT NVL(ca.CALCULATE_GROUP_CODE, ca.CALCULATE_CODE)) FROM CALCULATE ca WHERE ca.OPERATOR_CODE = #{authorCode} AND ca.STATUS = '정산완료' ), 0) AS COMPLETED_COUNT, NVL(( SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT NVL(ca.CALCULATE_GROUP_CODE, ca.CALCULATE_CODE)) FROM CALCULATE ca WHERE ca.OPERATOR_CODE = #{authorCode} AND ca.STATUS IN ('정산대기', '정산보류') ), 0) AS REQUESTED_COUNT FROM DUAL

SELECT cr.OPERATOR_CODE AS AUTHOR_CODE, cr.ACTIVITY_NAME AS BUSINESS_NAME, m.NAME AS AUTHOR_NAME, CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR2(50)) AS BANK_NAME, cr.SETTLEMENT_ACCOUNT AS ACCOUNT_NUMBER, cr.SETTLEMENT_ACCOUNT_IMG AS BANKBOOK_PATH, CAST(NULL AS DATE) AS UPDATED_AT FROM CREATOR cr JOIN MEMBER m ON m.MEMBER_CODE = cr.MEMBER_CODE WHERE cr.OPERATOR_CODE = #{authorCode}

SETTLEMENT_ACCOUNT = #{accountNumber},

mapper.sql: SELECT p.PAYMENT_CODE, p.RESERVATION_CODE, c.CLASS_CODE, c.NAME AS CLASS_TITLE, p.AMOUNT AS PAYMENT_AMOUNT, ROUND((p.AMOUNT - NVL(p.REFUND, 0)) * 0.1) AS FEE_AMOUNT, (p.AMOUNT - NVL(p.REFUND, 0)) - ROUND((p.AMOUNT - NVL(p.REFUND, 0)) * 0.1) AS SETTLEMENT_AMOUNT, s.CLASS_DATE AS AVAILABLE_DATE, '정산가능' AS SETTLEMENT_STATUS FROM PAYMENT p JOIN RESERVATION r ON r.RESERVATION_CODE = p.RESERVATION_CODE JOIN CLASS c ON c.CLASS_CODE = r.CLASS_CODE JOIN SCHEDULE s ON s.SCHEDULE_CODE = r.SCHEDULE_CODE WHERE c.OPERATOR_CODE = #{authorCode} AND p.STATUS = '결제완료' AND NVL(p.REFUND, 0) = 0 AND r.STATUS = '예약' AND TRUNC(s.CLASS_DATE) <= TRUNC(SYSDATE) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM CALCULATE ca WHERE ca.PAYMENT_CODE = p.PAYMENT_CODE)
mapper.insert:
SELECT SEQ_CALCULATE_GROUP_CODE.NEXTVAL FROM DUAL
INSERT INTO CALCULATE ( CALCULATE_CODE, PAYMENT_CODE, OPERATOR_CODE, MANAGER_CODE, COMMISSION, AMOUNT, STATUS, CALCULATE_DATE, CALCULATE_GROUP_CODE ) SELECT SEQ_CALCULATE_CODE.NEXTVAL, p.PAYMENT_CODE, #{authorCode}, NULL, ROUND((p.AMOUNT - NVL(p.REFUND, 0)) * 0.1), (p.AMOUNT - NVL(p.REFUND, 0)) - ROUND((p.AMOUNT - NVL(p.REFUND, 0)) * 0.1), '정산대기', SYSDATE, #{settlementCode} FROM PAYMENT p JOIN RESERVATION r ON r.RESERVATION_CODE = p.RESERVATION_CODE JOIN CLASS c ON c.CLASS_CODE = r.CLASS_CODE JOIN SCHEDULE s ON s.SCHEDULE_CODE = r.SCHEDULE_CODE WHERE c.OPERATOR_CODE = #{authorCode} AND p.PAYMENT_CODE IN
#{paymentCode}
AND p.STATUS = '결제완료' AND NVL(p.REFUND, 0) = 0 AND r.STATUS = '예약' AND TRUNC(s.CLASS_DATE) <= TRUNC(SYSDATE) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM CALCULATE ca WHERE ca.PAYMENT_CODE = p.PAYMENT_CODE)
mapper.sql: SELECT NVL(ca.CALCULATE_GROUP_CODE, ca.CALCULATE_CODE) AS SETTLEMENT_CODE, MIN(ca.CALCULATE_DATE) AS APPLIED_AT, MIN(CAST(p.PAYMENT_DATE AS DATE)) AS PERIOD_START_DATE, MAX(CAST(p.PAYMENT_DATE AS DATE)) AS PERIOD_END_DATE, COUNT(*) AS PAYMENT_COUNT, SUM(p.AMOUNT - NVL(p.REFUND, 0)) AS TOTAL_PAYMENT_AMOUNT, SUM(ca.COMMISSION) AS TOTAL_FEE_AMOUNT, SUM(ca.AMOUNT) AS SETTLEMENT_AMOUNT, CASE WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN ca.STATUS = '정산보류' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0 THEN '정산보류' WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN ca.STATUS = '정산대기' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0 THEN '정산대기' ELSE '정산완료' END AS SETTLEMENT_STATUS, CASE WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN ca.STATUS = '정산완료' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = COUNT(*) THEN MAX(ca.CALCULATE_DATE) END AS PAID_AT FROM CALCULATE ca JOIN PAYMENT p ON p.PAYMENT_CODE = ca.PAYMENT_CODE WHERE ca.OPERATOR_CODE = #{authorCode} GROUP BY NVL(ca.CALCULATE_GROUP_CODE, ca.CALCULATE_CODE)
mapper.select: SELECT settlement_group.SETTLEMENT_CODE, settlement_group.APPLIED_AT, settlement_group.SETTLEMENT_STATUS, settlement_group.TOTAL_PAYMENT_AMOUNT, settlement_group.TOTAL_FEE_AMOUNT, settlement_group.SETTLEMENT_AMOUNT, cr.ACTIVITY_NAME AS BUSINESS_NAME, m.NAME AS AUTHOR_NAME, CAST(NULL AS VARCHAR2(50)) AS BANK_NAME, cr.SETTLEMENT_ACCOUNT AS ACCOUNT_NUMBER, settlement_group.PAID_AT FROM () settlement_group JOIN CREATOR cr ON cr.OPERATOR_CODE = #{authorCode} JOIN MEMBER m ON m.MEMBER_CODE = cr.MEMBER_CODE WHERE settlement_group.SETTLEMENT_CODE = #{settlementCode}

SELECT p.PAYMENT_CODE, p.RESERVATION_CODE, c.CLASS_CODE, c.NAME AS CLASS_TITLE, p.AMOUNT AS PAYMENT_AMOUNT, ca.COMMISSION AS FEE_AMOUNT, ca.AMOUNT AS SETTLEMENT_AMOUNT, s.CLASS_DATE AS AVAILABLE_DATE, ca.STATUS AS SETTLEMENT_STATUS FROM CALCULATE ca JOIN PAYMENT p ON p.PAYMENT_CODE = ca.PAYMENT_CODE JOIN RESERVATION r ON r.RESERVATION_CODE = p.RESERVATION_CODE JOIN CLASS c ON c.CLASS_CODE = r.CLASS_CODE JOIN SCHEDULE s ON s.SCHEDULE_CODE = r.SCHEDULE_CODE WHERE NVL(ca.CALCULATE_GROUP_CODE, ca.CALCULATE_CODE) = #{settlementCode} ORDER BY p.PAYMENT_CODE
